question: Can a specialized visual-place-recognition identity source confirm a requested building from one public RGB view more reliably than the frozen generic CLIP/DINO identity sources?

frozen_scope.development: Six entities, 24 queries, one reference per entity.
frozen_scope.test: Six different entities, 24 queries, one reference per entity.
frozen_scope.prior_exclusion: All 12 entities are absent from the 20-entity PB1 manifest; the six PB1 confirmation buildings cannot select or evaluate a PB2 arm.
frozen_scope.portal_boundary: Portal proposer, portal crops, support rays, PB1 head, COMMIT, SET_VALUED, NONE, tracking, and active observation are not invoked.

B0_CLIP.descriptor: L2-normalized frozen whole-image CLIP image embedding

B1_DINOv2.descriptor: L2-normalized mean of frozen whole-image DINOv2 patch tokens

B2_CLIP_DINO.descriptor: Fixed arithmetic mean of per-query z-scored B0 and B1 entity-score vectors; no learned weight

C1_SALAD.descriptor: Official DINOv2-B/14 SALAD 8448-D descriptor; 322x322 bilinear resize and ImageNet normalization

C2_MixVPR.descriptor: Official ResNet50 MixVPR 4096-D descriptor; 320x320 bicubic resize and ImageNet normalization

scoring.entity_score: Maximum cosine similarity to that entity's frozen reference bank; v1 contains one reference per entity.
scoring.ranking: Rank all six entities within the query split by descending entity score with stable entity-ID tie breaking.
scoring.positive_episode: Pair every query with its audited true entity.
scoring.wrong_building_episode: Pair every query with each of the other five entities in its split.
scoring.acceptance: Accept a requested entity iff its pair score is at least the arm-specific threshold.
scoring.threshold_selection: On Development only, enumerate all observed positive and negative score midpoints and maximize balanced accuracy; tie-break by higher positive acceptance, lower wrong-building false confirmation, then higher threshold.
scoring.baseline_selection: On Development choose B0/B1/B2 lexicographically by Recall@1, positive acceptance, lower wrong-building false-confirmation rate, then Recall@3.
scoring.challenger_selection: On Development choose C1/C2 with the same lexicographic order. Carry the selected baseline, selected challenger, thresholds, and all formulas unchanged to test.

metrics: facade/entrance/side/partial stratified Recall@1 and positive acceptance

promotion_gate.identity_gain: Selected challenger test Recall@1 must improve by at least 0.10 absolute OR positive acceptance must improve by at least 0.10 absolute over the selected baseline.
promotion_gate.wrong_building_guardrail: Selected challenger wrong-building false-confirmation rate must be no more than selected baseline plus 0.02 absolute.
promotion_gate.positive_authority_guardrail: Selected challenger positive acceptance must be at least 0.25 and no more than 0.05 below the selected baseline.
promotion_gate.decision: All three clauses are required for L10_PB2A_SPECIALIZED_VPR_IDENTITY_GATE_MET. Otherwise record L10_PB2A_SPECIALIZED_VPR_IDENTITY_GATE_NOT_MET_STOP_SINGLE_FRAME_APPEARANCE_ONLY.

successor.gate_met: Open PB2-B spatial place support; retain portal and active-view blocks until spatial grounding passes.
successor.ranking_only_or_gate_not_met: Stop backbone, score, seed, threshold, and fusion sweeps on this cohort. Change information source to logo/OCR/map/metadata/GPS or a genuinely ordered multi-view observation.

backend: For each executable arm, time an equivalent frozen Development batch on CPU and verified CUDA. Select the faster backend, GPU on a tie; record actual tensor device, GPU name, timings, peak allocated memory, and selection reason.
claim_boundary: Curated public-image single-frame place-identity Development plus algorithm-fresh-by-PB2 building-disjoint confirmation. This is not a fresh-final or universal VPR benchmark. It establishes no portal ownership, access, traversability, active motion, tracking, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
